Our Mission

Power belongs to We the People.

The Michigan First Movement is a grassroots patriot organization built on the unshakeable conviction that strong, high-functioning local communities form the foundation of a strong state and nation.

Learn More About Our Mission →

Protect Our Communities

Strong families and thriving neighborhoods are the heart of a strong Michigan.

Restore Limited Government

Secure Freedom for Future Generations

We fight today so Michigan's children can live free tomorrow.
